objective: Lower held-out PPL at identical training tokens; no confirmation claim from this screen.
adaptive_rule: Trace-free Gram observations; bias-corrected EMA weighted Welford scatter V, squared normalized weights q; alpha=clip(q*V/((1-q)*norm(tracefree(mean))^2),0,0.1). First observation and beta2=0 use alpha=0. Stored Gram factors are not shrunk. Same root refresh, ridge, momentum, Adam graft and decay as parent.
gate: Run CPU numerical/probe checks, then GPU distributed correctness/profile and two-step model smoke before adaptive LM training. Compare initial cases before expanding the LR grid. Failures, unfavorable results and boundary optima remain in the record.
promotion: A favorable initial run permits LR expansion; it does not establish improvement. Before promotion require a bracketed LR neighborhood, a second development seed and full 3250-step comparison against a tuned baseline. Keep confirmation seeds and reserved validation slice unopened.
interpretation: The estimator is justified only for stationary independent factor observations. Training drift and temporal correlation violate those assumptions. Lower factor Frobenius error is not a guarantee of better inverse-root directions or PPL. Cap=1 is a synthetic diagnostic only, not an implicitly selected LM variant.
